label: SYNTHETIC ADVERSARIAL SCENARIO 13: Name Collision (Two Different People, Same Name)
description: Two distinct natural persons share the name 'John Smith' across different entities (e.g. John Smith of London born 1970 holding 15% directly, and John Smith of Edinburgh born 1985 holding 15% through MidCo). System must handle or flag disambiguation collision.

documents.content_text: Target Corp 13 Ltd Members Register: John Smith (DOB May 1970, London) holds 15% directly. Smith HoldCo Ltd holds 30% directly.
PSC confirmation: John Smith (DOB Nov 1985, Edinburgh) holds 50% shares in Smith HoldCo Ltd.
